note: Facts from Toll's own reads of Robinhood Chain, not advice. A coin that is not listed is not cleared.

reasons.sells_fail: A small test sell through the coin's main pool failed: its hook stops sells.
reasons.lp_pullable: One wallet holds the main pool's liquidity and can pull it.
reasons.dev_sold: The dev sold a large share of the supply.
reasons.first_seconds_buys: Wallets bought a large share of the supply in the pool's first seconds of trading.
reasons.declared_bundle: The launch made wallets other than the dev exempt from the opening tax (a declared bundle).
reasons.holder_concentration: The ten biggest wallets hold most of the supply.
reasons.dev_coordinated_sell: The dev sold in the same tenth of a second as other wallets.
reasons.linked_wallets_hold: Linked wallets (one funder, or bought together) hold a large share of the supply now.
reasons.large_sell_into_pool: A wallet sold a large share of the supply into the pool or curve.
reasons.strong_finding: A finding that Toll's pre-buy check blocks on; the check page names it.
reasons.rugged_24h: Rugged within 24 h of launch, as scored on Toll's launch record (/record).
reasons.lp_removed_24h: Whoever added the launch liquidity removed most of it within 24 h of launch (the tx is given).
